Theme

northern adjective

also north (as in the north side), northerly, in the north

classical

Varr. RR 1.2.4; Plin. NH 2.177 (Lewis & Short)
Tac. Agr. 10: septentriōnālia Britanniae (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 205, 352

septentriōnālis, septentriōnāle

The adjective of septentriōnēs, the seven stars of the Plough and so the north (see north). Cicero and Caesar more often use the noun with a preposition, ad septentriōnēs; as a noun, septentriōnālia are the northern parts.

Other words

  • aquilōnius, aquilōnia, aquilōnium — northern, northerly

    also used · classical · Cic. N.D. 2.50: quae tum est aquilōnia tum austrālis (Lewis & Short)

    From aquilō, the north wind (see north wind).

Examples

  • quae tum est aquilōnia tum austrālis

    which is now northern, now southernCic. N.D. 2.50 (Lewis & Short)

See also north, north wind, southern.
